description: Screen Share — Choose a screen to show, invite people with a room code or link, and talk through what they see. Screen Share uses your browser’s capture permission.. Runs in the browser. Covered by signup welcome credits and by the Day Pass (24-hour unlimited on this workspace group). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
